page.name: Maine DOE Website
page.intro: The Maine DOE website is a resource for public-facing materials and resources for school staff and community members.
page.content:
You should bookmark our website for fast and easy viewing! www.maine.gov/doe

  • We use a content management system (CMS) called Drupal to publish content to the website.
  • We run ongoing audits (pages, links, files) to ensure that our information is accurate, accessible, and trustworthy.
  • Many teams have a content editor but should always work with the webmaster when creating new spaces/pages/projects.
  • All pages are moderated through a website-specific workflow.
  • All files on the website follow our File Naming Convention
  • Please reach out to the webmaster if things are off anywhere on the website!
